subject.title: fix(qqbot): add timeout to remote media URL fetches

question: Should this PR keep the fixed 120s QQBot remote-media deadline once real proof is added, or should the timeout policy change before merge?
rationale: The code path is the right owner boundary, but the diff intentionally turns very slow remote media into a fail-fast `null` result and no maintainer has accepted that cutoff yet.

options.title: Keep 120s after proof
options.body: Require redacted real behavior proof for the stalled-media path, then accept the fixed plugin-local 120s deadline as the compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Adjust timeout policy
options.body: Ask for a different maintainer-approved deadline or policy shape before merge if two minutes is not the right QQBot media cutoff.

options.title: Pause this PR
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want a fixed QQBot media fetch deadline in this plugin path.

recommendation.title: Keep 120s after proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted real behavior proof for the stalled-media path, then accept the fixed plugin-local 120s deadline as the compatibility tradeoff.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current helper path and adjacent QQBot timeout work, making them the best available owner for accepting the merge-risk tradeoff.
